title: Cancel an order
request:
Add `OrderController.handle_cancel(order_id)`.

- A `placed` order becomes `cancelled`: return status 200 with the order body (same shape as `handle_create`'s response) showing `"status": "cancelled"`. Later `handle_get` and `handle_list_for_customer` responses show the new status.
- Cancelling an order that is already cancelled returns status 409 with `{"error": "order already cancelled"}` and changes nothing.
- An unknown order id returns status 404 with `{"error": "order not found"}`.
plausible_shortcuts: Fetch and overwrite the order through the repository from the controller.
Decide whether the cancellation is allowed inside the controller.
shortcut_note: For readers and reviewers only. Never shown to the agent; the agent receives `request` alone.
